facts.fact: The Ministry of Health's Annual Health Sector Performance Profile 2024 states that DHIS2, under the ministry's Monitoring and Evaluation Unit, is the main source of routine statistical data, its components being the health facility monthly and annual reports; it reports 47,982,589 outpatient attendances for Tanzania Mainland in 2024 from it.
